### SYS-0001: Survive a power cut

After a power cut every node shall return to service without a person.

*Rationale.* Nobody is there at night.

- Status: approved
- Verification: test
- Source: robohub/docs/requirements/system.yml:6
- Satisfied by: GW-0001
- Decided by: ADR-0001
- Changed: 2026-11-01

<a id="sys-0002"></a>

### SYS-0002: One enrollment per board

A board shall be enrolled once and stay enrolled.

- Status: verified
- Verification: test
- Source: robohub/docs/requirements/system.yml:17

<a id="gw-0001"></a>

### GW-0001: Sessions survive a gateway restart

After a restart the gateway shall re-establish a session with every enrolled board within 30 s, without re-enrollment.

*Rationale.* A power cut must not need a person.

- Status: approved
- Verification: test
- Source: gateway/docs/requirements/node.yml:6
- Satisfies: SYS-0001
- Satisfied by: GW-AUTH-0001
- Decided by: ADR-0001, robohub:ADR-0001
- Owner: maintainer
- Changed: 2026-11-19
- Tags: security

<a id="gw-0002"></a>

### GW-0002: Enroll a board once

The gateway shall keep a board's enrollment across restarts.

- Status: verified
- Verification: test
- Source: gateway/docs/requirements/node.yml:18
- Satisfies: SYS-0002
- Changed: 2026-11-10
